fields.description: Completed a comprehensive hands-on course covering the full spectrum of Machine Learning and Deep Learning. Topics included supervised and unsupervised learning, natural language processing, reinforcement learning, and model deployment on AWS. Built and trained models using both Python and R, working with real-world datasets across regression, classification, clustering, and neural network architectures.

Earned a Gold category certificate (70% and above) in Digital 101 on the FutureSkills Prime platform, an initiative by the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, Government of India, in collaboration with NASSCOM. Achieved an overall score of 88.89% (112/126) across three modules assessed at NSQF Level 4, aligned to competency standards developed by the IT-ITeS Sector Skills Council.

Completed a rigorous 12-week NPTEL certification course on Programming in Java, conducted by IIT Kharagpur under the Swayam platform. Achieved an Elite grade with a consolidated score of 82% (Online Assignments: 21.56/25.
The course covered core and advanced Java concepts including OOP principles, exception handling, data structures, multithreading, and file I/O  assessed through weekly assignments and a proctored final examination.
